author: Inside Edition
description: A masked person, appearing to have a gun, was caught on surveillance at the home of Savannah Guthrie's mother, Nancy Guthrie, the night she was kidnapped. The images were recovered despite the fact that the cameras themselves had been taken or destroyed, according to authorities. Savannah posted the images Tuesday after they were released by the FBI. The break in the case comes less than 24 hours after Savannah's plea for help from the public.
title: Surveillance Shows Masked Person At Nancy Guthrie's Home

author: Inside Edition
description: Delia Rollek says a man burst into her home and duct-taped her. The kidnapper dragged the elderly woman outside demanding money. As she was about to be driven away, her daughter drove up and scared off her kidnapper. The kidnapper was her roofer, Jason Kester, who was sentenced to 13 years in prison. Heddy Braun, 88, was taken from her home in 2003. Her abductor sent a ransom note demanding $3 million. Braun was found days later in subzero temperatures. Her abductor was her handyman.
title: Elderly Woman Speaks Out After Being Kidnapped

author: Inside Edition
description: Singer Brooke Josephson announced she and her husband, TV executive producer Barry Josephson, are getting divorced. In a statement Brooke revealed she was "unaware of Barry's relationship with Jeffrey Epstein" during their entire marriage. In a statement, Barry says in part, "There's no excuse for what I said in some of my emails," and "While I did attend social events with Epstein, and he did visit my sets twice, I never traveled with him on his plane, visited his island, or saw him in the company of minors."
title: Singer Announces Divorce With TV Producer After Epstein Revelation

author: Inside Edition
description: Around 380 extras hit the stadium with Bad Bunny dresses as stalks of sugar cane and blades of grass blew many away at the Super Bowl halftime show. Morgan Benson, a 29-year-old model and actress from Minnesota, spoke with Inside Edition about being in the show. Bad Bunny did his own stunts and refused to wear a harness while on top of a light pole during the performance. Inside Edition caught up with Victor Villas, the owner of the Los Angeles taco shop featured in the show.
title: Nearly 400 Dressed As Sugar Cane And Grass At Super Bowl Halftime Show

author: Inside Edition
description: A Turkish medical worker may have seen his life flash before his eyes during what should have been a routine snack break. The frightening incident happened in southern Turkiye, and was caught on a surveillance camera. Ilyas was sitting at a table in an office, having some food. He was by himself. But the scene took a terrifying turn. Ilyas appeared to be struggling, putting his hands to his throat. His airway was obstructed, and he was unable to breathe.
title: Choking Man Saves His Own Life

author: Inside Edition
description: Cesarina Johnson heard a buzz outside her window and started recording the Amazon delivery drone as it crashed into her apartment building in Richardson, Texas.
title: Amazon Delivery Drone Crashes Into Apartment Building #shorts
